name: ChicBlocko
desc:
🏙️ Welcome To ChicBlocko!

Run the streets. Grow an empire. Build your reputation.

ChicBlocko is an open world city located in Chicago where EVERY decision matters. Make money legally, take the fast money route, or balance both. Will you rise to power, or will you get left in the streets?

📱 Equip your phone to find new Jobs, & Explore.

💰ROBBERIES
🚗BUY & FLEX LUXURY CARS
💥EXPLODE CARS
🎮CONSOLE SUPPORT
🚨POLICE
🏠HOMES & PENTHOUSES
📦SAFE STORAGE
♠️ARCADE
🔫TRADE CUSTOM GUNS
AND MORE❗

Your choices define your outcome.
Will you be the next in power.. Or get left behind?

🔔 Join the group for updates, events & more.

You get menu access in PRIVATE SERVERS you OWN!
